g.text: Defence layers: two hard boundaries, four guardrails
Strongest at the top. The first two layers hold even when a plugin, a prompt or a project config is hostile.
internal network · egress proxy · no host gateway
non-root · cap-drop ALL · no-new-privileges · no SSH by default
pids / memory / cpu limits · read-only config
/etc/opencode/opencode.jsonc · hard deny, loaded before the project
proxy and broker logs are authoritative · plugin audit is tamperable
record the lease id on every request
Plugin hooks are not a sandbox. They shape behaviour;
the kernel and the network boundary are what actually hold.
